reuse.why: Reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance, but does not consolidate the worst-case amount rule into a shared helper (e.g. alongside getScheduledAmount) despite two existing copies.

duplication.why: The identical approximate-amount branch is pasted into both pre-existing copies of the worst-case expression (shared/schedules.ts and server/api-models.ts), deepening the duplication.

placement.why: Edits land where the rule is already applied, but the planning rule belongs in one shared/schedules function that the API model calls rather than in an inline nested ternary in each layer.

scope.why: Only the worst-case amount computation and a focused test are touched.

maintainability.why: A four-level nested ternary now duplicated in two layers; any future amount-op change must be found and edited twice.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getApproxNumberThreshold is used; no existing worst-case helper existed to bypass (getScheduledAmount implements the midpoint rule, a different decision).

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicate in api-models.ts is a verbatim copy, not disguised.

one_place.where: The rule change is applied separately inline in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions (shared/schedules.ts) and scheduleModel (server/api-models.ts).
